baseline_reproducibility: exact original64 head and direct calibrated final head/math; exact fresh GREEDY/DIRECT_CALIBRATED routes/outcomes from accepted recovery
cache: reuse exact prior authenticated497-row feature cache and externally held original binding/evidence; no cache write/copy or trace reconstruction
calibration: one fixed weighted minimum-change final-Linear least-squares solve; frozen64-trained hidden features; no parameter selection
legacy_admission: original IL world/context envelope authenticates reconstruction only; new actual caps are stricter and independently enforced
scientific_scope: Simulator-generated recorded traces in annotation-assisted real TRAIN anatomy; no measured surgical outcomes, negative-preparation-success evidence, held-out improvement, Q optimality, clinical or physical claim

selection.DIRECT_CALIBRATED: positive predicted directQ ranks actual-positive candidates; exact GREEDY fallback if no positive directQ; immediate reward is already included in directQ
selection.TAIL: actual immediate nominal reward plus max(0,raw predicted continuation tail), exactly one current reward contribution; rank only actual-positive candidates
selection.deployment_excludes: recorded future rewards/targets, corpus features, labels and private reference outcomes
selection.shared: same full certified inventory and actual-immediate-positive guard; original inventory-order ties; STOP iff no actual-positive candidate

tail: one fixed float64 weighted SVD minimum-change final-Linear solve about direct-calibrated readout, cutoff1e-8; frozen64-trained hidden layer; target best recorded subsequent prefix with STOP0
target: Q_i=r_i+max(0,Q_(i+1)); STOP=0; current negative action cost preserved
training: frozen IL64 full policy, separate actor-MLP clone,64 full-batch Adam updates lr.001 clip5; equal subject/trace/state mass; only logged action rows supervised
